out: At the time of 1895 Eulmisabyeon (Assassination of Empress Myeongseong in 1895), Myeongseonghwanghu (Empress Myeongseong) was harmed by Japanese people in the Okhoru area where was Gonnyeonghap (Queen’s Residence).

out: It was confirmed that Chunhuidang and Bogwangdang originally existed at the Balgul Josa (Archaeological Excavation) to Hamhwadang (Bedchamber) locations from 2005 to the following year.

src: 1872년 흥복전에서 영혜옹주의 부마 간택이 열려서 박영효가 뽑혔습니다.

src: 1444년 세종 26년에는 연생전에 벼락이 쳐서 궁녀가 목숨을 잃었다는 기록이 있습니다.

out: 1444 There is a record that in the 26th year of Sejong, a court lady lost her life due to a thunderbolt at Yeonsaengjeon (Royal Bedchamber Hall).
